claims.claim: Numeric items require unitRef; nonnumeric items prohibit it.
Monetary/shares types constrain unit shape and namespace; currency validity also depends on the context period.
Repeated measures represent products with multiplicity; matching opposite-side measures must not occur.
DTR percent values remain ratios; perShare is a monetary amount divided by shares, despite base decimal typing.
All selected unit-presence and scoped shape/type checks pass; currency history remains unverified.
